explanation: The border follows the lower Tumen River to the sea. China, North Korea and Russia all meet close to the river's mouth.

claims.text: North Korea and Russia share a short land border.
The border between North Korea and Russia follows the lower Tumen River to the sea.
The borders of China, North Korea and Russia meet near the mouth of the Tumen River.
